thread.title: U.S. stock futures sharply lower, led by tech as rout continues

author: Stocks News Feed
title: U.S. stock futures sharply lower, led by tech as rout continues
text:
U.S. stock futures tumbled on Tuesday, a day after heavy losses for Wall Street, with tech stocks again setting up for a tough session. Dow futures
 YMZ8, -0.56%
 slid 151 points, or 0.6%, to 24,869, while S&P 500 futures
 ESZ8, -0.58%
 dropped 18.55 points, or 0.7%, to 2,678. Nasdaq-100 futures
 NQZ8, -0.84%
 tumbled 75.25 points, or 1.1%, to 6,597. On Tuesday , the Dow industrials
 DOW, -0.88%
 slid over 400 points on weak economic data and the Nasdaq Composite
 COMP, -3.03%
 dropped 3%. Apple Inc.
 AAPL, -3.96%
 , a big loser Monday, was again down in premarket amid lingering concerns about demand for its new iPhone models. As well as stock futures oil prices were off sharply, with January West Texas Intermediate crude
 CLF9, -0.61%
 down nearly 1% and January Brent crude
 brnf9
 down over 1%.
